prompt:
Our computational vaccine design team has just completed a full round of calculations for nanocarrier candidate NCV-07. The results are sitting in the project_alpha folder under /workspace. We need a formal, structured audit report before we decide whether to commit resources to the next (very expensive) simulation phase.

Please review all the available calculation outputs for NCV-07 and write a complete audit report to a file named audit_report.txt. The report must cover all the evidence from the structure predictions, the surface exposure analysis, the short equilibration runs, and the long production simulations. Based on that evidence, it should give a clear final recommendation: should we proceed, wait for more data, or terminate this candidate?

Be careful: there are archived results from a different candidate (NCV-05) in the folder — those should not influence the NCV-07 decision. Also, the team has been known to report high model confidence scores without checking whether the actual molecular geometry holds up, so please flag any such discrepancies.
